interpretation: Common and native auctions are separate conditions; identical auctions reuse physical games. Only unplayed source deals are allocated; completed source records are unchanged.
model_note: Gen6 bots use the gen6 play engine (bridge_harness/gen6.py): lead belief net at the opening lead, hand-fit scorer on hand-type classes until the deal list starts, the scorer-weighted deal list after that, and the policy net only among cards within near_tie of the best. Their bidder is the Gen 6 candidate. Every other bot is unchanged from the source run. docs/gen6_architecture_2026-11-11.md has the details.

difference_definition.unit: IMPs per board, candidate minus opponent
difference_definition.bidding: Native minus common on the same board; includes auction/play interaction
difference_definition.uncertainty: Student-t intervals on paired per-board differences; exploratory, unadjusted for repeated monitoring
